exclusions: Ground-only ambulance programs are not additional air bases.
Historical Garden City and Pittsburg registry records are not treated as current air bases; neither appears in the current EagleMed air-service location list.

The conflicting Olathe HealthStar directory address and former Lee’s Summit location are not separate additional bases. Public affiliate, hospital and practice-address evidence supports the Overland Park campus.

geometry.source: US Census Generalized ACS 2024, 500K state/county geometry
geometry.method: WGS84 geodesic circles and county-edge distance comparisons.

limitations: Approximate reference points are labeled; they are not surveyed aircraft parking positions. Hays uses the public airport address reference, not an asserted specific hangar.
Public records support program/site identification, not real-time staffing or flight availability.
County geometry is generalized, not a cadastral survey.
Neighboring-state inventories remain incomplete until their increments are reviewed.
